stemMd: A circle has radius 10. An arc is subtended by a central angle of $72^\circ$. What is the arc length?
explanationMd: The arc is 72/360=1/5 of the full circle. Circumference is 2π(10)=20π, so arc length is 20π/5=4π.

distractorRationale.c: This uses half of the correct circumference fraction.
distractorRationale.d: This omits π and does not apply the angle fraction.
